title: The Leaven
review_status: DRAFT: retelling and wondering questions require theological and editorial review before release.

source.note: Original child-friendly retelling written for this prototype; not a quotation of any translation. See also Luke 13:20-21.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: This is a story Jesus told. Let's carry the material to the table, and listen.

segments.text: Jesus told another story about the Kingdom of God. He said it is like leaven, the yeast that makes bread dough rise.
A woman took a little leaven, just a small piece.
She put it into three big measures of flour, enough to make bread for a great many people.
She mixed the leaven all through the flour, until it was hidden and no one could see it anymore.
Then she waited. The leaven worked quietly, where no one could see.
And little by little, all of the dough rose.

wonderings: I wonder how a little leaven can change so much flour.
I wonder what the woman did while she waited.
I wonder what grows quietly, where no one can see.
I wonder what the Kingdom of God is like.

feedback.all_good: Each figure is resting in its place.

outro.speaker: narrator
outro.text: The material is back on the shelf. It will be here whenever you want to return to it.

journal_line: I listened to the story of the leaven, and saw a little leaven make all the dough rise.
